class.name: Vehicle
class.brief_description: Godot composition root for a configured, simulated vehicle.
class.description:
Vehicle owns setup and physics-frame ordering while delegating running gear and drivetrain phases to value-owned components. Configure one [VehicleConfig] resource and exactly-two-wheel [Axle] children before runtime. Setup validation is fail-closed. Configuration and part resources are copied into runtime models; replacing the config or editing those resources does not change active runtime behavior until [method restart]. Restart revalidates the Vehicle's current direct [Axle] children, reapplies the copied resources, and does not respawn the body or hot-swap child [Wheel] topology.
The optional [Marker3D] assigned to [member center_of_mass_marker] is an Inspector convenience for authoring the center of mass. After setup validation succeeds and before running-gear setup begins, each successful setup or restart converts the marker's global position to Vehicle-local coordinates and applies it as [constant RigidBody3D.CENTER_OF_MASS_MODE_CUSTOM]. If the marker is [code]null[/code], Vehicle leaves the [RigidBody3D] center-of-mass mode and value untouched, preserving manual rigid-body configuration.
The drivetrain exposes command methods for shifting. Telemetry is assembled as an immutable C++ [code]VehicleTelemetrySnapshot[/code] value rather than a live component reference.

signal.name: vehicle_ready
signal.description: Emitted after successful initial setup or restart.

method.name: set_center_of_mass_marker
method.description: Sets the optional Inspector marker used to author the center of mass during setup or restart.

method.name: get_center_of_mass_marker
method.description: Returns the optional center-of-mass authoring marker.

method.name: set_config
method.description: Sets the setup resource used by the next initialization or [method restart]. Replacing it does not reconfigure the active runtime immediately.

method.name: get_config
method.description: Returns the configured setup resource.

method.name: set_gearbox_automatic
method.description: Switches the live gearbox between automatic and manual mode. The current gear and any active clutch/gear-change phase are preserved; queued manual input is cleared.

method.name: get_gearbox_automatic
method.description: Returns whether the live gearbox is in automatic mode.

method.name: restart
method.description: Revalidates and rebuilds copied runtime state from the current [VehicleConfig], referenced resources, and direct [Axle] children. Reapplies tire, steering, suspension, aerodynamics, ESC, and drivetrain resources without changing child-wheel topology. Existing body transform and linear/angular velocities are preserved. Returns [code]true[/code] and emits [signal vehicle_ready] on success; returns [code]false[/code] and leaves the Vehicle inert on failure.

method.name: set_throttle_input
method.description: Sets throttle input; the value is clamped to [0, 1].

method.name: get_throttle_input
method.description: Returns the clamped throttle input.

method.name: set_steer_input
method.description: Sets steering input; the value is clamped to [-1, 1].

method.name: get_steer_input
method.description: Returns the clamped steering input.

method.name: set_brake_input
method.description: Sets brake input; the value is clamped to [0, 1].

method.name: get_brake_input
method.description: Returns the clamped brake input.

method.name: shift_up
method.description: Queues a command to shift up through the gearbox.

method.name: shift_down
method.description: Queues a command to shift down through the gearbox.

method.name: select_drive
method.description: Queues a command to select forward drive.

method.name: select_neutral
method.description: Queues a command to select neutral.

method.name: select_reverse
method.description: Queues a command to select reverse.

method.name: set_abs_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables anti-lock brake modulation.

method.name: get_abs_enabled
method.description: Returns whether anti-lock brake modulation is enabled.

method.name: set_tcs_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables traction-control throttle reduction.

method.name: get_tcs_enabled
method.description: Returns whether traction control is enabled.

method.name: set_substeps
method.description: Sets physics substeps per frame; the value is clamped to [1, 1024].

method.name: get_substeps
method.description: Returns physics substeps per frame.

members.member: Crankshaft spin axis in chassis-local coordinates, normalized on assignment. Use Z for a longitudinal engine or X for a transverse engine. Reverse the vector to reverse spin direction. Its magnitude does not scale strength. Zero disables engine reaction/vibration; nonfinite values are ignored. Requires [member VehicleConfig.engine_reaction_data]. May be changed at runtime without restart.

Optional Inspector [Marker3D]. On each successful setup or restart, its global position is converted to Vehicle-local coordinates and applied as the custom center of mass before running-gear setup. [code]null[/code] leaves the [RigidBody3D] center-of-mass mode and value unchanged.

Setup resource containing required engine, gearbox, suspension, and optional aerodynamics/ESC/turbo data. Its values are copied during setup or [method restart]; later edits take effect on the next successful restart.
Whether anti-lock brake modulation is enabled.
Whether traction-control throttle reduction is enabled.
Physics substeps per frame, clamped to [1, 1024].
